newsitem.title: USA: McLeod Inc completes financing program.
newsitem.headline: McLeod Inc completes financing program.

text.p: McLeod Inc said Thrusday it raised equity capital and issued senior discount notes over the last nine months to raise nearly $1 billion.
The company said the funding will allow it to accelerate expansion plans, technology and network development and new product offerings.

McLeod, operating as McLeodUSA, said telephone users in Iowa and other Midwestern states will also benefit from improved telecommunications services, employment opportunities and community investment.
McLeod provides integrated local and long distance services to business and residential customers.
Its shares closed up 7/8 Thursday at 19-3/8.
